design_rules: Mandatory: Use actual KiCad power symbols for all supply and ground rails, never plain text or local/global labels as their visible substitute. Use named custom power symbols for nonstandard rail names, preserving exact net names and intended scope; keep raw, fused, protected, switched supplies and isolated returns separate. Hierarchical pins may express sheet interfaces; ordinary labels remain suitable for signals and measurements. PWR_FLAG is an ERC source declaration, not a substitute for a supply symbol. Put flags on short net extensions, hide power-symbol/flag pin numbers, align to the grid, orient supplies up and grounds down where practical, and prevent field/wire overlaps. Inspect all sheets, run ERC, and compare connectivity after conversions. Emit KiCad 10.
